translation: Man: Where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha... where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha... You're heading down the road, Rajitha... where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha
Woman: To the riverbank, my golden Raju... to the riverbank, my golden Raju... I'm going there to play, Raju... to the riverbank, my golden Raju
Man: Where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha... where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha... You're heading down the road, Rajitha... where are you off to, girl, lovely Rajitha
Man: Why play a game without a partner... why play a game without a partner... Shall I come along to keep you company, Rajitha... why play a game without a partner
Woman: Enough, enough of your flirting talk... enough, enough of your flirting talk... You go on your way, Raju... enough, enough of your flirting talk
Man: Wait, just wait, you graceful girl... wait, just wait, you graceful girl... I have something to tell you, Rajitha... wait, just wait, you graceful girl
Woman: If anyone should see you and me... if anyone should see you and me... they'll heap blame on us, Raju... if anyone should see you and me
Man: When I come close to you, wanting you... when I come close to you, wanting you... why do you keep your distance, Rajitha... when I come close to you, wanting you
Woman: When a strange man comes up beside me... when a strange man comes up beside me... wouldn't I feel shy, Raju... when a strange man comes up beside me

Man: You won't let me touch you, you won't let me hold you... you won't let me touch you, you won't let me hold you... Why are you like this, Rajitha... you won't let me touch you, you won't let me hold you
Woman: With no wife yet and nothing settled... with no wife yet and nothing settled... how could that ever work, Raju... with no wife yet and nothing settled
Man: If you agree, I'll marry you... if you agree, I'll marry you... and look after you in grand style, Rajitha... if you agree, I'll marry you
Woman: I would agree, my golden Raju... I would agree, my golden Raju... but a snag has come up, Raju... I would agree, my golden Raju
Man: Tell me, do tell me, lovely Rajitha... tell me, do tell me, lovely Rajitha... what snag has come up for you, Rajitha... tell me, do tell me, lovely Rajitha
Woman: I can't speak up against my family... I can't speak up against my family... what am I to do, Raju... I can't speak up against my family
Man: If you say yes, lovely Rajitha... if you say yes, lovely Rajitha... I'll win your family over, Rajitha... if you say yes, lovely Rajitha

Woman: If that's how it is, that's good, so come on then, dear... if that's how it is, that's good, so come on then, dear... Go and fix the wedding date, Raju... if that's how it is, that's good, so come on then, dear
summaryEn:
This romantic duet is a playful conversation between a young man, Raju, and a young woman, Rajitha, whom he meets on the road. He asks where she is going; she says she is off to the riverbank to play. From there the song unfolds as a courtship in question and answer. He offers to keep her company, and she brushes off his flirting. He begs her to wait, and she worries that people who see them together will spread gossip. When he complains that she keeps her distance and won't let him touch her, she replies that any girl would be shy with a man who is not her husband, and that such closeness makes no sense without marriage.

The mood shifts when he proposes to marry her and care for her well. She is willing, but cannot go against her family, so he promises to persuade them himself, and the song ends happily with her telling him to go and fix the wedding date. The song captures village ideas of modesty, family honour and consent to marriage in a light, humorous way. Every line follows the same pattern, a half-line sung twice, a new phrase, then the opening repeated, giving the exchange a steady, dance-like rhythm.
summaryTe:
ఈ ప్రేమ యుగళగీతం దారిలో ఎదురైన రాజు అనే యువకుడికి, రజిత అనే యువతికి మధ్య సాగే సరదా సంభాషణ. ఎక్కడికి వెళ్తున్నావని అతను అడిగితే, ఏటి గట్టుకు ఆడుకోవడానికి వెళ్తున్నానని ఆమె చెబుతుంది. అక్కడి నుంచి పాట ప్రశ్న-జవాబుల రూపంలో ఒక ప్రేమ కథగా సాగుతుంది. తోడుగా వస్తానని అతను అంటే, సరసపు మాటలు చాలని ఆమె తిప్పికొడుతుంది. ఆగమని అతను బతిమాలితే, తమను ఎవరైనా చూస్తే నిందలు మోపుతారని ఆమె భయపడుతుంది. దగ్గరికి వస్తే దూరంగా ఉంటున్నావని, ముట్టనీయడం లేదని అతను బాధపడితే, పరాయి మగవాడు పక్కకు వస్తే సిగ్గుపడనా, పెళ్లి కాకుండా అదెలా కుదురుతుందని ఆమె జవాబిస్తుంది.

ఆమె ఒప్పుకుంటే పెళ్లి చేసుకొని గొప్పగా చూసుకుంటానని అతను మాట ఇచ్చినప్పుడు పాట మూడ్ మారుతుంది. ఆమెకు ఇష్టమే కానీ తనవాళ్ళకు ఎదురు మాట్లాడలేనని చెబుతుంది; అప్పుడు వాళ్ళను తానే ఒప్పిస్తానని అతను అంటాడు. చివరికి లగ్గం పెట్టుకోమని ఆమె చెప్పడంతో పాట సంతోషంగా ముగుస్తుంది. పల్లెల్లోని మర్యాద, కుటుంబ గౌరవం, పెళ్లికి పెద్దల అంగీకారం వంటి భావనలను ఈ పాట హాస్యంగా, తేలికగా చూపిస్తుంది. ప్రతి పంక్తి ఒకే తీరులో ఉంటుంది: మొదటి సగం రెండుసార్లు, తర్వాత కొత్త మాట, మళ్ళీ మొదటి సగం. దీనివల్ల సంభాషణకు ఒక స్థిరమైన, ఆటపాటల లయ వస్తుంది.
